entries.6b12ce70cd19a0ca: As its raison d'être (purpose), based on its management philosophy, the company aims to realize 'Sustainable Supply': turning off-grade eggs that do not reach the market into liquid and frozen egg, providing a stable volume at stable quality and fair prices, and building continuing relationships with customers. As medium- to long-term growth strategies, the company plans to push active capital investment at all plants in the Liquid Egg Business to reach liquid egg sales volume of 80,000 tons and a 20% industry share by fiscal 2030, to strengthen proposals for new markets such as health foods in the Seasoning Business, and to expand sales in the Organic EC Business by enriching its product lineup.

entries.804fe3b3d5de263a: In its core Liquid Egg Business, the company is expanding sales volume and strengthening supply capacity under a structure in which selling prices and purchase prices are linked to egg market prices, and it aims for stable supply by diversifying procurement, including use of imported eggs and contract production. The Seasoning Business seeks higher value added and stronger proposals for new markets, and the Organic EC Business seeks to expand its product lineup, so the company is also pursuing growth in businesses other than the Liquid Egg Business.

entries.b385269a14a9bb21: The business model is one in which the company and its two consolidated subsidiaries manufacture and sell liquid eggs, frozen eggs and processed egg products in the liquid egg business, manufacture and sell powdered and granulated seasonings for business use in the seasonings business, and sell organic foods through an EC site in the organic EC business.
entries.c487b348bcefe7cc: It is an egg processing manufacturer headquartered in Kasuya-machi, Kasuya District, Fukuoka Prefecture. The company and two consolidated subsidiaries form the group, and the consolidated number of employees in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 184. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange.
entries.ca7661fcaec41aed: The company's main business is liquid egg and frozen egg, made by cracking eggs and removing the shells. It also manufactures and sells processed egg products and seasoning powders and granules for business use, and it purchases and sells organic and all-natural products through an EC site.
entries.d655edd692149a18: Liquid egg is positioned as a 'semiconductor of food' used in many processed foods for business use, and the company states that its strengths lie in its domestic egg procurement capacity, its imported egg procurement capacity and its liquid egg supply capacity. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, while other liquid egg makers restricted supply due to a shortage of eggs caused by avian influenza, orders and OEM orders to the company increased, and liquid egg sales volume reached a record high of 66,660 tons. The company has manufacturing bases in four divisions (Fukuoka, Kanto, Nagoya and Kansai), and each division as well as consolidated subsidiary Nihon Kako Shokuhin has obtained food safety management system certification.
